tokenisation.sentences: week05_text.sentences(): paragraphs at line breaks, then spaCy's rule-based sentencizer
tokenisation.dropped: heading lines (under 45 characters, no full stop, six words or fewer) and every sentence under External links, Further reading, Notes, References, See also
tokenisation.words: runs of letters in any alphabet, an inner apostrophe or hyphen kept, lowercased, a possessive 's removed; digits and punctuation dropped
tokenisation.names: every node's title without disambiguation and each real name in its description, matched case-sensitively as whole words, replaced by [name] in the masked models
tokenisation.model: trigram: P(w3 | w1, w2) from counts inside one community, sentences padded with <s> <s> and </s>; no smoothing and no backoff, since sampling only reaches contexts seen in training
tokenisation.generation: 5 sentences sampled word by word from <s> <s> until </s>; a sentence that reaches 40 words is thrown away and redrawn
